questions.text: We __________ our friends's birthday and we _________ how to make it up to him.
questions.solution:
The adverb "completely" goes before the verb: "completely forgot". "Just" goes before "don't know": "just don't know".

Answer: completely forgot --- just don't know

questions.text: Choose the statement where underlined word is used correctly.
questions.solution:

Only "All personnel are being given the day off" uses it correctly.

Answer: All personnel are being given the day off

questions.text:
Based on the given statements, select the most appropriate option to solve the given question.
What will be the total weight of 10 poles each of same weight?

Statements:
I. One fourth of the weight of the pole is 5 Kg.
II. The total weight of these poles is 160 Kg more than the total weight of two poles.
questions.solution:
Checking each statement:
- I: weight = 4 [latex]\times[/latex] 5 = 20 kg [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] total = 200 kg. Sufficient.
- II: 10w = 2w + 160 [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] w = 20 [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] total = 200 kg. Sufficient.

Answer: Either I or II alone is sufficient
